posts.name: Cyous
posts.cooked:
If you are reading/editing the memory of the client/exe, install 3rd party dll files, etc, then you’re in the realm of hacking. If you are automating responses based on strings, this is not bannable per se. (IMO; addons have access to SendChatMessage() )

Basically, you’re trying to modify the client to allow you to read data and then write to the client, you’re literally breaking every section of the TOS with respect to hacking.

To emulate ChatGPT with respect to addon functionality, you’d need to rewrite ChatGPT as a Lua-sourced OpenAI project – which is just way beyond the scope of Lua.

In short, if you want to work on AI projects, apply to the company and work on it directly, otherwise you’ll be at risk for a ban for hacking/automation/botting.
